Author: XivHub
Name: AutoPincher
Punchline: Reprices all your retainer listings 1 gil under the cheapest seller, in one click.
Description:
Undercuts the cheapest competing listing by 1 gil for every item your retainers are selling. It reads your listings from game memory and uses the market board's Compare Prices to find the lowest current price. It never goes below what a vendor would pay or above your own cheapest copy, and it ignores your other retainers and housing mannequins, so two of your retainers selling the same item don't undercut each other.

Nothing is sent to a server unless you turn on the developer log and point it at your own. Adds an Auto Pinch button next to AutoRetainer's retainer list and a /autopinch command for the open retainer. AutoRetainer is optional; if it is installed, its automation pauses during a run.
